773.name: slots
773.docs:
Returns the contents of the menu, including the player's inventory. `None` if the container is closed
(the fake handle is always open until dropped).

1704.name: entity_id_by_minecraft_id
1704.docs: Get an `Entity` in the world by its `MinecraftEntityId`.

646.name: operations
646.docs: Real: `azalea::inventory::operations` (azalea_inventory). Same shapes minus `QuickCraft`, which nothing binds.

819.name: container
819.docs:
Real: `azalea::container` (azalea/src/container.rs). `ContainerHandle` derefs to `ContainerHandleRef` and
closes the container when dropped; the fake prints when that happens.

1700.name: entity
1700.docs: Get an `EntityRef` for the client's own entity.

1719.name: get_inventory
1719.docs:
Returns a `ContainerHandleRef` to the client's open container, or their inventory. The fake has no open
container, so this is the inventory. Dropping it sends nothing (unlike `ContainerHandle`).

1338.name: properties
1338.docs:
Real: `Arc<GameProfileProperties>` whose `map` is an `IndexMap`, which the generator can't map, so
(as with the real azalea) `Client::profile` is skipped and hand-written in extra_state.rs.

1715.name: get_held_item
1715.docs:
Get the item in the bot's hotbar that is currently being held in its main hand.
The fake holds a stack on the first call and nothing afterwards.

1211.name: RwLock
1211.docs:
Stand-in for `parking_lot::RwLock`, which `Client::world()` really returns inside an `Arc`: `read()` gives a
guard directly (no `Result`), which is how real code calls `world.read().get_block_state(..)`.

1738.name: any_entity_by
1738.docs:
Generator fixture for slice 25: a plain `impl Fn(Entity) -> bool` (no type parameters).
Returns the first entity the predicate accepts, or None.

1788.name: physics
1788.docs: Returns the complete `Physics` data for this entity.

1784.name: minecraft_id
1784.docs: Get the Minecraft ID of this entity.

1707.name: direction
1707.docs: Returns the direction the client is looking.

322.name: BlockKind
322.docs:
Real: `azalea::registry::builtin::BlockKind`. `FromStr` accepts "stone" or "minecraft:stone";
`to_str()` (and `Display`) give `minecraft:<id>`. The fake only knows a handful of blocks.

1126.name: ReachBlockPosGoal
1126.docs: Real: has a private `max_check_distance`, so the generator skips it (`bot:goto_reach` is hand-written).

1780.name: attack
1780.docs: Attack this entity from the client that created this `EntityRef`.

772.name: close
772.docs: Real: triggers a `CloseContainerEvent` for this container id.

1703.name: entity_ref_for
1703.docs: Create an `EntityRef` for the given ECS entity.

922.name: ClientInformation
922.docs: Same fields as the real `ClientInformation` (a Component there; the fake needs no ECS).

418.name: get_block_state
418.docs:
Real: `Some(state)` for any loaded position, `None` outside the loaded world. The fake world: nothing
below y=0, bedrock at 0, stone up to 62 (one diamond ore), dirt at 63 (one water block), air above.

1749.name: health
1749.docs: Get the health of this client.

1722.name: nearby_players
1722.docs: Returns every player entity in render distance.

1745.name: attributes
1745.docs: Returns the attribute values of our player.

1718.name: wait_for_container_open
1718.docs:
Wait until a container is open, up to the specified number of ticks. `None` on timeout. The fake opens one
straight away, except that `Some(0)` times out.

1741.name: position
1741.docs: Get the client's position in the world.

1714.name: menu
1714.docs: Return the menu that is currently open, or the player's inventory if no menu is open.

1737.name: best_tool_in_hotbar_for_block
1737.docs:
The fake hotbar: slot 1 shovel, slot 2 pickaxe, slot 3 axe, everything else bare hand. Like the real one it
answers `index: 0, percentage_per_tick: 0` for fluids and for blocks nothing can mine (bedrock).

1510.name: Init
1510.docs: Right after the client is created.

1710.name: tab_list
1710.docs: Get a map of player UUIDs to their information in the tab list.

1810.name: azalea
1810.docs: Fake azalea: just enough surface (same shapes as the real one) to compile-check generated bindings.

1583.name: Physics
1583.docs: Real: `azalea_entity::Physics` (plain pub fields, `on_ground()` is a method).

1102.name: indexmap_like
1102.docs: Stand-in with the same generic shape as `indexmap::IndexMap<K, V>`.

394.name: ChunkStorage
394.docs: Real: `azalea_world::ChunkStorage` (a boxed `ChunkStorageTrait`, `Clone`). `ReachBlockPosGoal` takes its own copy.

1048.name: ClientboundPlayerCombatKill
1048.docs:
Real: `azalea_protocol::packets::game::ClientboundPlayerCombatKill`, which the protocol crate's
`declare_state_packets!` macro re-exports (hence the generator's PATH_OVERRIDES entry).

1702.name: entity_by_uuid
1702.docs: Get an `EntityRef` for an entity with the given UUID, if it's in render distance.

1725.name: nearest_entities_by
1725.docs:
Returns every entity that matches the predicate, nearest first. Real: `Q: QueryData, F: QueryFilter`,
`predicate: impl EntityPredicate<Q, F>` (any `Fn(ROQueryItem<Q>) -> bool`). The fake world holds the
bot (id 7), two players (1, 2), a zombie (3) and a cow (4); `Q` is `()` or `&EntityKindComponent`.

1721.name: open_inventory
1721.docs: Open the player's inventory. Returns `None` if another container is open (the fake never has one).

1717.name: open_container_at_with_timeout_ticks
1717.docs:
Open a container in the world, or time out after a specified amount of ticks. The fake errors below y=0
(real: the world read fails).

1790.name: health
1790.docs: Get the health of this entity.

28.name: into
28.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

909.name: entity
909.docs: Real: `azalea::entity` is `azalea_entity` (`EntityKindComponent(pub EntityKind)` derefs to the kind).

1713.name: component
1713.docs:
Get a component from this client. Real: `component<T: Component>` returning a `MappedRwLockReadGuard<T>`
(derefs to `T`); the fake only knows `Inventory` and returns a clone.

1736.name: world
1736.docs: Get an `RwLock` with a reference to our (potentially shared) Minecraft world.

1786.name: attributes
1786.docs: Returns the attribute values of the entity.

1709.name: account
1709.docs: Returns the `Account` for our client (infallible, like the real one).

1782.name: position
1782.docs: Get the entity's position in the world.

774.name: click
774.docs: Simulate a click in the container and send the packet to perform the action.

1705.name: entity_by_minecraft_id
1705.docs: Get an `EntityRef` in the world by its `MinecraftEntityId`.

1778.name: id
1778.docs: Returns the ECS identifier for the entity.

393.name: block
393.docs:
Real: `azalea::block` (azalea_block). Its `BlockState` is a state id (stone has one state, stairs many);
the fake just wraps the kind. `BlockState::from(kind)` is the default state, `BlockKind::from(state)` drops the state.

1701.name: EntityRef
1701.docs: A reference to an entity in a world (real: `azalea::entity_ref::EntityRef`, re-exported at the root).

743.name: Menu
743.docs:
Real: a big enum with one struct variant per menu kind (`Player { .. }`, `Generic9x3 { contents, player }`, ...),
`Debug`-derived, with `slots()` = every slot in protocol order.

1724.name: nearest_entities
1724.docs:
Returns an array of `EntityRef` for all known entities that match the given filter, sorted by nearest first.
(Real: generic over `F: QueryFilter`; the fake has the same shape.)

1747.name: physics
1747.docs: Returns the complete `Physics` data for this client.

1720.name: set_client_information
1720.docs: Change the client information; the real one also sends a packet when logged in. The fake prints it.

1643.name: Attributes
1643.docs: Real: `azalea_entity::Attributes`, one pub `AttributeInstance` field per attribute.

1743.name: minecraft_id
1743.docs: Get the Minecraft ID of this client.

1666.name: AccountTrait
1666.docs: Real: `azalea::Account` (a cloneable handle that derefs to `dyn AccountTrait`).

1716.name: open_container_at
1716.docs: Open a container in the world, like a chest. Times out after 5 seconds (100 ticks).

1739.name: map_health
1739.docs: Generator fixture for slice 25: `impl Fn(f32) -> f32` (simple scalar round-trip).

908.name: FakeQuery
908.docs: Stand-in for bevy's `QueryData` in the fake: how to turn a world row into the predicate's argument.

1712.name: hit_result
1712.docs:
Returns the current `HitResult`: the block or entity in the client's crosshair.
The fake alternates: block first, entity from the second call on.
